commands_used: answer 1. I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka, the order of the Xeech-Leel. The Hist trees are sickening because of the Unbound and Cuts-the-Old-Knot, who drain sap and seal the scars with paralysis paste. We want the Eye of Argonia before them, to heal the trees at the Root. 2. Go to the Grey Tooth Cave on the north face and find what the Collectors hired men found there. 3. Fight the three hirelings, slip past them, talk to them, or read the rubbing here. 4. I do not fully understand what the Root gate or the Eye really is, nor exactly what the Collector wants. I could learn more from the rubbing and by talking.

answer 1. Same hunt for the Eye of Argonia for the Toh-Reel-Ka. The Grey Tooth niche is empty: a sailor scratched that the stone went to the ship Stormwidow by her captain order, 20 years ago. The Collector Vanin has sold the ships name to diggers. 2. Go to the Wreck of the Stormwidow on the south-west beach of Skeith Isle and search the hold for the kings stone. 3. Fight or slip past whoever is at the wreck, or talk to them; search the ballast crate. 4. I do not know what the kings stone is exactly or what it does, nor who is digging at the wreck. I may find out at the wreck.

answer 1. I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka. I took the kings marker stone from the Stormwidow ballast crate before the Unbound scouts got it. It shows seven towers in water, one cut deeper than the rest, matching the Vicrium map. I also took the Unbounds seal recipe. 2. Speak to the wounded scout Tah-Leesh on the sand below the bow of the Stormwidow. 3. Talk to her; I could also fight the scouts or leave. I only have one topic with her so far, Who are you. 4. I do not know which tower is the deeper one means, or where the seven towers are. Tah-Leesh or the order may tell me.

answer 1. I hold the kings marker stone. Tah-Leesh, an Unbound scout, says her leader Cuts-the-Old-Knot tells servants of the Toh-Reel-Ka to ask what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth, the Archwardens fort on the Chixathe Mesa. She does not know what it means. It hints the order hides something, perhaps connected to why Cuts-the-Old-Knot turned on them. 2. Bring the marker stone to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka House, Helstrom. 3. Go to Helstrom and deliver it; I could also ask Never-Writes-Twice about the Fort Chalkmoth riddle, or go see the fort myself. 4. I do not understand what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, nor whether the Unbound speak truth. I could ask Never-Writes-Twice or Nesh-Deeka, or visit the fort.

answer 1. The quest is complete. Never-Writes-Twice read the stone: the seven towers are drowned spires off Lilmoth on the sea floor of Benthic Yobesh, and the divers of Bell Station know which tower is marked. She paid me 100 gold and kept the stone. She brushed off Fort Chalkmoth as an ordinary fort, which makes me a little suspicious. 2. Go by boat from Lilmoth to Bell Station, an islet east of Lilmoth, to find the marked tower; or first visit Fort Chalkmoth on Chixathe Mesa above Noota Nara. 3. Either order. I can also keep questioning Nesh-Deeka and Never-Writes-Twice about the order. 4. I do not know what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, why the Unbound want me to ask, or what Benthic Yobesh holds. I can learn by going to the fort and the divers.

answer Grey Tooth quest done. The Grey Tooth cave niche was empty; a rubbing said the stone went to the Stormwidow, beached on Skeith Isle south-west shore. I took the Kings Marker Stone from its ballast crate (Unbound scouts were there; a wounded scout, Tah-Leesh, did not fight). I also took the Unbounds Recipe for the Seal, signed C.: grey caps and dried root ground into paste, numbs, pressed into the scar after the drawing. I still carry it. I gave the stone to Never-Writes-Twice in Helstrom and got 100 gold. She says the seven towers are the drowned spires off Lilmoth in Benthic Yobesh; the divers of Bell Station, an islet east of Lilmoth reached by boat from Lilmoth, know which tower is marked. Tah-Leesh said Cuts-the-Old-Knot tells the Toh-Reel-Ka to ask what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth (Archwarden fort, Chixathe Mesa above Noota Nara). Never-Writes-Twice dismissed it, which I find suspicious. Next: Bell Station for the tower, or Fort Chalkmoth first. The Collector Vanin is also digging ahead of us.
